name: QES Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，QES Group Berhad 通过新加坡子公司收购两处办公单位，并签署谅解备忘录探索与 Ray Tech Singapore 的合作；同时，其全资子公司 QES Manufacturing 出售了在 Applied Engineering Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的30%股权。
overview_en: In 2026, QES Group Berhad acquired two office units through its Singapore subsidiary and entered into a memorandum of understanding with Ray Tech Singapore Pte. Ltd. to explore collaboration; meanwhile, its wholly-owned subsidiary QES Manufacturing disposed of its 30% equity interest in Applied Engineering Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 设备
segments.note: 今年该板块通过新加坡子公司收购办公单位，并签署谅解备忘录探索合作。
segments.note_en: This segment acquired office units through its Singapore subsidiary and entered into a memorandum of understanding to explore collaboration this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接子公司 QES (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. 以 SGD5,470,000 收购位于新加坡 Space Nova 的两处办公单位。
actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary QES (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. acquired two office units at Space Nova, Singapore for SGD5,470,000.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 QES Mechatronic Sdn. Bhd. 与 Ray Tech Singapore Pte. Ltd. 签署谅解备忘录。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary QES Mechatronic Sdn. Bhd. entered into a memorandum of understanding with Ray Tech Singapore Pte. Ltd.

segments.name: 制造
segments.note: 今年该板块出售了在 Applied Engineering Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的30%股权。
segments.note_en: This segment disposed of its 30% equity interest in Applied Engineering Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 QES Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM1,134,000 出售其在 Applied Engineering Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的全部30%股权。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary QES Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. disposed of its entire 30% equity interest in Applied Engineering Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. for RM1,134,000.
